scope: Replay the retained prospective-plan and six native metadata records; fixed public repository node IDs exactly once, never choose by issue content or outcomes.
candidate: Exact configuration from results/observation-development-20261020/selection.json; compare actual standard-wire proof before capture; no further candidate edits.
owner: root owns standard gh API calls, private raw custody and native Git retention; W owns pure source, R independently replays actual raw before sampling

publicMetadata.before: All fixed repository IDs -> current {id,nameWithOwner,isPrivate}; require public before any body request; current name and original scope name are distinct.
publicMetadata.after: Repeat all fixed IDs after all body requests; require identical ID/name/public observations. Change or uncertainty invalidates the entire frame, no replacement/exclusion.
publicMetadata.limitation: Non-atomic authenticated API: public at observed pre/post checks does not prove no transient private transition between them. On change/unknown, retain raw privately and do not publish or sample it. No new auth or proxy.

prior.productPaths: all retained experiments/**/*.json, including old605 metadata100 and actual bodies, plus all613 captured118
prior.globalIds: Extract explicitly typed issue identities from both sources before scope resolution. Old native57 Issue references are56 unique; union with613118 is174 known IDs. Prior captured metadata also contains2 oversized excluded Issues, giving176 global IDs. Explicit PR/pullRequests records are not Issue identities despite the legacy generic issueNodeId field. Exclusion is independent of current repository or edited body; metadata/reference identity does not imply body observation.
prior.resolver: All reference repository names -> metadata-only identity; original responses stay private. Only resolved public IDs in the fixed scope may receive issueOrPullRequest identity queries. Outside/private/null metadata never enters public manifest; outside unresolved references alone do not invalidate the frame. A known in-scope unresolved identity or saved/current identity conflict is fail-closed pending version resolution, never silently choose a preferred ID.
prior.bodyExclusion: Exact prior body bytes, including different issue with same prior body; no semantic near-clone filtering. New-frame duplicates remain one issue one weight.

body.endpoint: repos/<current public name>/issues?state=all&sort=created&direction=asc&per_page=100 via standard gh --paginate --slurp; normal exit and all original pages retained
body.unit: one captured complete issue body; no title/comment/link supplement; latest observed version during capture, not atomic as-of snapshot
body.eligibility: non-PR, before cutoff, not globally known issue, not exact prior body, nonempty, all actual bestO/scopedO/sharedE serialized requests <24000 bytes; keep all exclusions and coverage
body.failure: partial/missing/repeated target traversal, unresolved target identity, API failure, timeout, visibility/name change or >1h -> FRAME_INVALID; no sampling or model calls

sampling: After native frame retention, reuse existing real-cases/sample.mjs once with crypto Fisher-Yates, n=min(300,M), suffix reserve sealed; empty frame is not success
gold: root/R independent body-only initial labels using original split.mjs hasExpectation/hasObservation/question, not new candidate scope text; predictions blinded, candidate design known. Freeze originals before sharing, adjudicate before model outputs, null remains assigned.
disclosure: All frame bodies and reserve stay in root private native custody. R replay prints only aggregate/IDs/sizes; raters view selected body-only Gold views. Product/W receive selected corpus and sampling only after candidate freeze, never the reserve.
inference: Keep prospective round2 primary unchanged: n cap300, two passes, each tail1/800, all-unknown conservative ranges and both-pass AND. Sharp Gold-completion bounds are a mathematically valid alternative discussed before fresh outputs, but not a primary acceptance rescue in this round.
